summary: All 14 figure-selected RNA-seq genes agreed in direction with the registered chronic HFD versus chow result. Only Trh and Npy among the six published limma-voom discoveries passed registered BH FDR < 0.05. The Dryad archive also identified all 20 mice in the ten registered pools. The proposal records a selected-gene comparison without full verification.
openIssues: High-filter MAANOVA marks C4b as a chronic-diet hit and Agrp as a four-group hit. The prose says both methods found the same six chronic genes. The original model output would settle the discrepancy.
The reviewed public sources lack a genome-wide table of fitted author effects. The 14 plotted directions fall below the 30-pair concordance minimum.
Inconsistent supplemental panel labels limited the S4 Table post-hoc comparison to four unambiguous RNA-seq panels.
